description: This file defines a mock class 'TestModuleMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule' and uses Google Mock to mock its methods. It includes mock methods for various RPC calls related to a test module in the Rialto IPC component.

classes.name: TestModuleMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule' used in unit testing, providing mocked implementations of RPC methods and utility functions for generating responses.

methods.name: TestRequestSingleVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a single variable test request.

methods.name: TestRequestMultiVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a multi-variable test request.

methods.name: TestResponseSingleVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a single variable response.

methods.name: TestResponseMultiVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a multi-variable response.

methods.name: TestRequestSingleVarNoReply
methods.description: Mock method for handling a request with no reply.

methods.name: defaultReturn
methods.description: Utility method to simulate a successful RPC call by invoking 'done->Run()'.

methods.name: failureReturn
methods.description: Utility method to simulate a failed RPC call by setting controller failure and invoking 'done->Run()'.

methods.name: getSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Generates a 'TestSingleVar' response with specified 'var1' value.

methods.name: getMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Generates a 'TestMultiVar' response with specified 'var1', 'var2', 'var3', and 'var4' values.
